_comment: A worked asset-catalog.json as /real-create-catalogue emits it, used to generate examples/reel.example.json. Deliberately imperfect: two clips share one tag (so the binder has to pick and show its runner-up), three components have nothing that fits (so stubs are emitted), one asset is a published reference cut that must never be bound, and one is junk.

script_beats.gist: Takes 1 — hook through the wrong instinct.
Take 2 — what actually makes the sound, through the payoff.

assets.role: ★ DEMO — same note, heavy+slow then light+fast
assets.shows: 9.6s, 1080x1920. Camera at bow height looking down the string toward the bridge. One continuous take: first stroke slow and pressed and choked, second stroke fast and light and open. The difference is audible.
assets.use: The demo the whole reel exists to prove. Runs clean, at full volume, narration stops over it.
assets.binds_to: a `<video clip of the same note bowed twice in one continuous take>` type component — the demo

assets.role: ★ B-roll — index finger pressing into the frog
assets.shows: 6.2s, tight shot on the right hand only, no face. The index finger visibly leans down into the frog mid-note.
assets.use: The wrong instinct beat — the literal picture of 'they lean in'.
assets.binds_to: a `<video clip of a player's right index finger pressing into the frog>` type component

assets.role: ★ B-roll — full bow stroke, frog to tip, POV
assets.shows: 7.8s, filmed over the player's own right shoulder. One unbroken stroke, the arm travelling the whole width of frame.
assets.use: The fix beat — 'full bow, same weight'. Pairs with the caption 'same weight. more bow.'
assets.binds_to: a `<video clip of a full-length bow stroke frog to tip, from the player's point of view>` type component

assets.role: Split screen — two bow arms, same note
assets.shows: 11.2s. Two bow arms side by side playing the same slow note; left short and stiff, right long and travelling.
assets.use: Only used by the question-first hook variant.
assets.binds_to: a `<video clip of two side-by-side bow arms on a split screen>` type component

assets.role: ★ Macro — bow hair pressed flat into the string
assets.shows: Extreme close-up, dark background, shallow depth of field. The hair is visibly bending against the string.
assets.use: Cold open. The picture of the problem before anybody has named it.
assets.binds_to: a `<show image of bow hair pressed flat into the string, extreme close-up>` type component

assets.role: ★ Diagram — string vibrating in a wide arc
assets.shows: Side view of a single string swinging in a wide arc, motion blurred at the belly, dark background. The width of the arc is the point.
assets.use: The explanation beat — 'how much of it you set moving'. First of a matched pair with the collapsed-arc frame.
assets.binds_to: a `<show image of a single string vibrating in a wide arc>` type component

assets.role: ★ Diagram — same string, arc collapsed to nothing
assets.shows: Identical framing and colours to the wide-arc frame, but the arc is almost flat. Second of the matched pair; the difference reads at a glance.
assets.use: 'The string never gets to vibrate freely' — the crushed sound, drawn.
assets.binds_to: a `<show image of the same vibrating-string frame with the arc collapsed>` type component

assets.shows: Two waveform plots side by side on identical axes. Left: a ragged flattened blob labelled 'pressed'. Right: a clean even oscillation labelled 'moving'.
assets.use: 'Pressure without speed isn't tone, it's friction.'
assets.binds_to: a `<show image of two waveform plots side by side, pressed vs moving>` type component

assets.shows: Plain series-style title card, white text on black, the words 'SPEED IS TONE'.
assets.use: The payoff. Lands on the final line and holds.
assets.binds_to: a `<show image of a plain title card in the series style>` type component

assets.role: ★ SFX — one crushed, airless bowed note on the D string
assets.shows: 3.1s of a single long bowed D, airless and choked, no narration under it.
assets.use: Cold open. The bad sound, before anybody knows what they are listening to.
assets.binds_to: an `<audio of one long crushed, airless bowed note>` type component

assets.role: SFX — one clean ringing open D, fading
assets.shows: 4.4s. A single clean open D allowed to ring and fade out.
assets.use: Under the title card at the end.
assets.binds_to: an `<audio of one clean ringing open D fading out>` type component

assets.shows: 31.4s of narration: the hook line through the wrong-instinct lines.
assets.use: The authoritative clock for the first half once it is aligned.
assets.binds_to: the narration spine for the opening beats

assets.shows: 34.9s of narration: the explanation beat through the payoff line.
assets.use: The authoritative clock for the second half once it is aligned.
assets.binds_to: the narration spine for the explanation, demo, fix and payoff beats

assets.role: Caption list from the previous cut
assets.shows: 24 cues in the creator's own phrasing: IT'S NOT PRESSURE / FRICTION / NO ROOM TO VIBRATE / SAME WEIGHT. MORE BOW. / SPEED IS TONE.
assets.excerpt:
it's not pressure
friction
no room to vibrate
same weight. more bow.
speed is tone
assets.use: Ready-made on-screen text, already the right length.
assets.binds_to: a `<caption: it's not pressure>` type component — any on-screen text slot

assets.shows: 58s, 576x1024, captions burned in. The finished cut of the previous video in this series.
assets.use: NOT source footage. Evidence about the edit, never material for one.
assets.binds_to: nothing — never bind a component to this

assets.role: Stock — violin lying on a desk
assets.shows: A violin on a wooden desk beside a laptop. Generic.
assets.use: Low value, no obvious beat. Candidate for deletion.
